answer_1.quote: document-level machine translation has received increased attention in the MT community.

answer_2.quote: We compare BLONDE with 11 other metrics and demonstrate that BLONDE is better at distinguishing between context-aware and context-agnostic MT systems.

answer_4.quote: Our human assessment is provided by four professional Chinese to English translators and four native English revisers.
answer_4.guideline: Raters are asked to evaluate system outputs relative to each other in terms of fluency and adequacy at both sentence and document levels, using isolated sentences for sentence-level evaluation and sequential blocks of five sentences for document-level evaluation.
